Rendering adheres closely to instructions: every round includes the required blocks, avoids introducing new causal factors, remains event-centric and in-universe, and maintains coherent timing and update frequency. Any deviations, if present, are marginal and do not meaningfully affect interpretation of the agent’s behavior under the intended configuration.
